title: Chinese Cats Can Fly
subtitle: A kung-fu commute home
description: A cat clocks out at six and has to fly home before dinner goes cold. Canal, bamboo grove, city wall, rooftops, the last hundred metres - each stretch only answers to one kung-fu move, and the wrong one is a very public wipe-out.

catalog.eyebrow: A sixth glimmer has woken up
catalog.headline: Work's over. Fly home.
catalog.description: A cat clocks out at six and has to fly home before dinner goes cold.
catalog.cardDescription: Canal, bamboo, city wall, rooftops, the last hundred metres. Each stretch answers to one kung-fu move - the wrong one is a public wipe-out.

states.label: Kung fu
states.description: How many moves you got right

states.label: Wipe-outs
states.description: How many times you made a scene

scenes.title: Six o'clock. Work's over.
scenes.description: The punch clock beeps once. Home is across the river and dinner is at six-thirty. You push the window open - tonight you fly.

actions.name: Hop onto the sill
actions.hint: One flick of the tail and you're up

take-off.text: You step onto the sill and the wind lifts your fur. First stretch is the canal - water is faster than road.

scenes.title: Crossing the canal: water moves faster
scenes.description: The canal is glassy still, with a row of stone posts down the middle. Twenty yards away, the far bank is already waving at you.

actions.name: Gecko Wall Climb
actions.hint: Hug a wall - but there isn't one here

water-stride.text: Seven taps on the water skin and you're on the far bank. Not a wet hair.

wall-climb.text: You latch onto a bridge post and slide into the water, tail and all. Good news: you can swim.

cloud-ladder.text: You shoot up beautifully, then land back where you started. The far bank is still twenty yards away.

scenes.title: The bamboo grove: the stalks spring back
scenes.description: A whole grove of bamboo, swaying together in the wind. From the tallest tips you can just see the way home.

actions.name: Cloud Ladder
actions.hint: Chain the push-offs, tip to tip

actions.name: Wave Step
actions.hint: It needs ripples to stand on

cloud-ladder.text: Three bamboo tips, three pushes, and you're over the whole grove - scaring up a flock of birds on the way.

water-stride.text: You kick at open ground. There's no water, only soil. Face first.

wave-step.text: You look for ripples in mid-air, find nothing, and wedge yourself between two stalks.

scenes.title: The old city wall: one vertical problem
scenes.description: The wall is high, grass sprouting from the brick seams. Going around costs half an hour; going up is much faster.

actions.name: Water Stride
actions.hint: This is a wall, not water

wall-climb.text: Claws into the seams, one storey at a time. Sixty feet of wall, twenty seconds flat.

water-stride.text: You search the wall for water, find a puddle at its foot, and step in two inches deep. Entire paw, filthy.

tile-step.text: You make the top, hit one loose brick, and slide all the way back down with a clatter.

scenes.title: The rooftops: this is cat territory
scenes.description: A run of old houses joined together - tiles, laundry lines, cat paths. All of it is your home ground.

tile-step.text: Two faint prints on the tiles, and not one person in the block disturbed.

wall-climb.text: The wall climbs fine, but the gap between the two buildings isn't crossable. You hang in mid-air for a long, awkward while.

cloud-ladder.text: You go up, then straight into someone's laundry line. Shirt, socks and cat, all tangled in the air.

scenes.title: The last hundred metres: home is right below
scenes.description: Your balcony light is on and dinner smells all the way up to the sixth floor. A hundred metres, straight down.

actions.name: Cat Landing
actions.hint: Nothing at all - you were born a cat

cat-landing.text: You relax everything and land on all four paws. Nobody can learn this move.

water-stride.text: You look for a splash of water on the concrete and land hard on your backside. Someone upstairs opens a window.

cloud-ladder.text: You shoot up three storeys and hook onto a higher laundry line. Dinner smells like it's below you.

endings.title: Dinner is still hot
endings.description: Six twenty-nine. You land on your own balcony without a single fall. The soup just reached the table. The human looks up and says: how did you get here so fast?

endings.title: The late kung-fu master
endings.description: You made it home, half soaked. Dinner is still warm. The human hands you a towel and you pretend it was rain.

endings.title: Practice again tomorrow
endings.description: After the last wipe-out you took the last bus. Dinner was cold and the human was watching TV. You didn't fly today - tomorrow, though.
